Teledyne e2v’s key product using directed energy technology is Safe Stop. This is a directed radio frequency energy system, which deactivates the engine management system of land vehicles and marine vessels to bring them to a controlled stop at a safe distance. The target vehicle or boat is unable to restart until the directed RF energy is turned off and Safe Stop is returned to passive mode. The occupants of the vehicles/vessels are not harmed. Safe Stop jams the control and command systems of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)/drones and these can be brought down or landed safely on the ground.
